nom: No7 Pure Retinol 1% Retinol Night Concentrate

segments.sensitive: Many reviewers describe sensitive skin; some report a burn or retinol reaction severe enough to stop use, while others who started slowly per the directions report no irritation at all.
segments.dry: The reviewer who specifies naturally dry skin found it agreed with her skin and required only a small amount.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 80s report visible fading of fine lines, and several in their 60s-80s specifically credit long-term retinol use for younger-looking skin.

concerns.aging: The great majority of reviewers report smoother texture and reduced fine lines and wrinkles within 2-6 weeks, especially around the forehead, mouth and eyes, though several say the deepest, long-set lines only partly respond.
concerns.redness: Redness and burning are common in the first days or weeks of use, especially without a buffering moisturizer, but most reviewers report it subsides within days and does not recur once skin adjusts.
concerns.dehydration: Dryness, flaking and peeling are widely reported, especially early on or when overused, and are generally described as an expected sign the retinol is working; a companion moisturizer or 'soother' product is frequently used to manage it.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of dark spots, acne scars and hyperpigmentation over weeks of use, though one reviewer saw no change in age spots she was treating on her hands.

aspects.libelle: Requires gradual introduction to avoid burning
Pairs well with the companion Post-Retinol Soother
Some feel it sits on skin without fully absorbing
Good value against prescription or pricier retinol brands

extraits.texte: This Retinol Concentrate did not do well for my skin. I do not have sensitive skin and have used, and know how to use, retinol products in the past. I ended up with burnt, stinging, and peeling skin on my face. It took over a week to et my skin back to normal.

I used the No7 1% retinol night concentrate sample I received free for my honest review for a few weeks every other night. I had to skip a couple nights because my face was drying out so bad. I was also concerned because I live in Arizona where it's sunny EVERY day and it says to avoid the sun. I have used extra sunscreen on my face daily feeling overly concerned. This would be a product I would use in the winter and not summer. Some of the fine lines toward the top of my cheeks seem to have diminished, but those are the only noticeable ones. My forehead looks the same, and it didn't make any noticeable change to the texture of my skin. My face doesn't burn, but does feel more sensitive using this. I would purchase it in the winter and try it again for longer to see if the results continue. Most other night products I've tried have had no visible results, this is an affordable option that shows promise. I would recommend it to others, but more so to people living in less sunny states.

My skin is sensitive, so I followed the suggested use and began with once a week applications. I noticed my skin peeling and looking smoother after about a week. I am now using this every other day with great results. My skin is smoother and softer than it has been in years.

I received this product for free as part of a BzzAgent Campaign for an honest review. I have been using retinol products for about a year and a half but still followed the directions provided. I started with every other night application and ended up with a retinol burn on my face. I've never experienced this before with any other retinol products. I stopped using the product for a few days and healed my face and then went back to using it and got another retinol burn. It's too harsh for my skin even with the soother.

I am someone who gets acne pretty often and even when i dont try to pop it, i still scar easily unfortunately. Ever since i started using this product my dark spots have gotten so much lighter with just 2 weeks of use! My friends and coworkers have told me how my scars are significantly lighter. Truly a life saver!

im 20 years old and have been looking to get into retinol, i have severe eczema so i am always nervous about using new skin care products i figured i woukd give it a shot and im glad i did! i put this on at night and the next day i had no dry patches on my face that i normally get especially sense its winter, day 2 my skin started to peel which is NORMAL, when you first start retinol your skin will peel a little because it is speeding up the process of skin shed which can cause large areas of dead skin to get stuck, i just lightly used my hands to rub my face jn the shower to remove the dead skin, day 3 i had peeling but it was alot less, did the same thing and day 4 no more peeling, soft smooth skin and i had no dry patches still !!!! i also have rosacea and i had very little redness!!! day 5 and 6 just great skin and i was able to wear makeup which is something i dont get to do often because if my eczema. Put it on again and had very little peeling and went right back to my skin being great. follow the directions and dont use this every day at first. Do once a week, then twice a week, then 3 times and so on so your skin can get use to it and ensure you arent having a reaction to it. But i love this stuff and i would highly recommend!!!
